en: A hand-colored vintage postcard showing a tranquil woodland scene with a pond or small river in the foreground, bordered by a simple wooden railing fence. Dense green trees and bushes surround the water, leading into a narrow, grassy waterway that extends into the distance under a pastel pink-and-blue sky. The bottom of the card has printed German text in red, including the place name 'Liebenwerda' and publishing information.
